"""RoboCasa RestockPantry, standard-mode RGB-D controller record.

This script documents the live controller used in the one-shot episode. It uses
only Robot observations, proprioception and camera calibration. World points are
reconstructed from RGB-D; there is no simulator-state or success-signal access.
"""
from __future__ import annotations
import sys
import time
import numpy as np
sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/tools")
from rcb_client import Robot

CAMERAS = [
    "robot0_agentview_center", "robot0_agentview_left",
    "robot0_agentview_right", "robot0_eye_in_hand",
]
DT = 0.05


def world_point(obs, camera, u, v):
    """Deproject one synchronized get_obs RGB-D pixel into world coordinates."""
    c = obs.meta["cameras"][camera]
    K = np.asarray(c["intrinsic_cv"], dtype=float)
    T = np.asarray(c["cam2world_gl"], dtype=float)
    depth = float(obs.depth[camera][0, int(v), int(u)])
    if not np.isfinite(depth) or depth <= 0:
        return None
    # OpenGL camera coordinates: +x right, +y up, camera looks along -z.
    q = np.array([(u-K[0,2])*depth/K[0,0],
                  -(v-K[1,2])*depth/K[1,1], -depth, 1.0])
    return (T @ q)[:3]


def action(dx=0, dy=0, dz=0, grip=-1, base_x=0, base_y=0,
           base_yaw=0, torso=0, mode=-1):
    return np.array([dx, dy, dz, 0, 0, 0, grip,
                     base_x, base_y, base_yaw, torso, mode], dtype=float)


def run_chunk(robot, rows, cameras=CAMERAS, note=""):
    rows = np.asarray(rows, dtype=np.float64)
    return robot.submit("ee_delta", rows, interpolate="hold",
                        cameras=cameras, video="none", note=note)


def capture(robot, tag):
    obs = robot.get_obs(cameras=CAMERAS, include_depth=True, video="none")
    obs.save(f"/app/output/{tag}")
    return obs


def repeat(a, n):
    return np.repeat(np.asarray(a, dtype=float)[None, :], n, axis=0)


def measured_delta(robot, target_world, max_steps=16, grip=-1):
    """Small, checked world-frame translations using measured EE feedback.

    The base is initially yaw-aligned so arm base x/y map to world +y/-x.
    Short chunks and fresh proprio feedback limit accumulated servo error.
    """
    out = None
    for _ in range(max_steps):
